summary: A 1924 log cabin with cupola was replaced by an R-6 flat-top cab on a tower in 1959; on emergency status, reached by a 1.2-mile wilderness trail; sources disagree on the forest and the 1924/1925 date.

facts.design: R-6 (Region 6 plan) flat-top cab on an enclosed tower, built 1959, replacing a log cabin with cupola (completed 1924; firelookout.com says 1925)

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts calls it 'Hike-In Emergency Use' and firelookout.com says it is on emergency status; no source says the cab is open to visitors or for rent. The trail to it is open to hiking, backpacking and horseback riding in the wilderness.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com put the site on the Boise National Forest. The Forest Service trail page for the route to the lookout lists the Salmon-Challis National Forest. Not resolved; the record keeps the Boise National Forest from the register.
The register and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1924 for the log cabin with cupola; firelookout.com gives 1925. The record and story use 1924 and report the other year.
The register gives 9,710 ft (2,960 m); firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 9,705 ft. The story says roughly 9,700 ft and gives both figures.

notes_for_editor: Built and replacement dates (1924 cabin, 1959 R-6 cab) agree across the register and Idaho Fire Lookouts; firelookout.com says 1925. The forest is disputed: the Forest Service trail page lists the Salmon-Challis National Forest while three other sources say Boise. Staffing is recorded as unstaffed/undated by inference from emergency status; the last known staff was 1983. firelookout.com's '10' treated timber tower' is ambiguous (tower or cab dimension), so no height is recorded. Current cab access is not established. Keeping Watch has coordinates only. Search results also pointed to a Facebook group post and a Boise National Forest history PDF; neither was used as a source because they were not read or did not mention Big Baldy in the cached text. The 1924 cabin and 1959 replacement are already in events, so the earlier '1959 built' correction is applied and the corrections list is cleared.
